text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 21px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start

g.text: Tests October 15 to 19, 2026 | One combined question bank | First attempts, failures included
Dot = median; tick = p95, using all 1,342 first-attempt durations. Dashed accuracy line = 20% uniform guessing.
Green/yellow/orange/red: median limits 250 / 500 / 1,000 ms; cost limits $0.010 / $0.025 / $0.050 per 1,000.
Hatched costs and + ? are incomplete lower bounds. ~ uses captured tariffs. The two-second eligibility rule uses median, not p95.
